title: High-Converting Landing Page for a Premium Car Dealership
excerpt: How we built a performance-optimized landing page with dynamic vehicle filtering and SEO-driven listing pages for Automobile Fink, a premium used car dealership in Munich.
challenge: Automobile Fink, a premium used car dealership in Munich, relied on third-party listing platforms for most of their leads. They had no owned digital presence and were paying steep commissions on every sale. They needed a standalone website that could rank for local automotive search terms and convert visitors into showroom appointments.
solution: We designed and built a conversion-focused landing page featuring a dynamic vehicle inventory with real-time filtering by make, model, price, and mileage. Each vehicle gets its own SEO-optimized detail page with structured data markup for Google rich results. The site includes an integrated appointment booking form, financing calculator, and a trade-in value estimator. Performance was a priority - the entire site loads in under one second on 4G connections.
results: 68% of new leads now come through the website instead of third-party platforms
First-page Google rankings for 12 local automotive search terms within 8 weeks
Average session duration of 4.2 minutes - 3x industry average
Showroom appointment bookings increased 45% month over month after launch
Commission savings of over 40% compared to third-party platform fees

testimonial.quote: webvise took us from zero online presence to ranking on the first page for our most important keywords in under two months. The quality of leads from our own site is significantly higher than what we got from listing portals.
testimonial.author: M. Berger
